[[Speak with Headmaster Quin (Ritualist)]] | followed by = [[Minions Gone Wild]] | profession = Ritualist | primary = y | secondary = n }} Leads new Canthan Ritualists to their first trainer. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = factions | profession = Ritualist | primary = y | secondary = n }} ===Objectives=== *Search [[Sunqua Vale]] for [[Professor Gai]]. ===Early benefits=== *{{skill icon|Painful Bond}} *{{skill icon|Pain}} *{{skill icon|Vengeful Weapon}} ===Reward=== * 100 [[Experience]] * 10 [[Gold]] ==Walkthrough== Gai can be found in Sunqua Vale, southwest of the exit from the monastery. Look for [[Kaabo Cemetery]] if you have trouble finding him. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Headmaster Quin ''The spirits tell me that Professor Gai is ready to begin your training in the Ritualist arts. It seems that some Necromancer or other has left us quite a mess to look after. Not that I am surprised. You'll find [[Professor Gai]] in [[Sunqua Vale]].'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I'll look for Professor Gai. | decline = I'm not ready yet. | ask = Just west of town, in [[Sunqua Vale]], is a small cemetery on a hill. Look for [[Professor Gai]] there. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Professor Gai ''Headmaster Quin believes you are ready for training, does she? Well, the spirits share many things with her that the rest of us cannot conceive. She is fortunate to have such omniscient allies, is she not? Well, we had better commence your indoctrination into the Ritualist arts.''
